excluded_samples.historical_v2_replay: forensic only; zero strict causal round trips
excluded_samples.v3_pilot: zero promotion credit because exit constants were mistranscribed and exit/settlement code was not locked
excluded_samples.v4_mixed_version: forensic only; multiple implementation lock identities share one activation and receive zero v5 promotion credit

baseline.entry: exact frozen consensus_v3_2026_07_16 selected candidates after strongest-bucket and event-lock processing
baseline.monitoring_cadence: the existing sequential five-minute watchdog run

registered_candidate_arms.single_change: reject unless post-latency full-quantity ask VWAP and marginal ask are at most 0.25
greatest whole-share FOK quantity not above baseline quantity whose entry cost plus explicit fee plus one adverse tick per share is at most 10 USD and meets minimum order size

add an exit at the first five-minute monitor decision whose full-position bid VWAP is at most 75 percent of entry VWAP; execute from a separate post-latency sell book and retain unfilled residual inventory

activation_and_stopping.forward_start: activation_utc in the generated v5 lock
activation_and_stopping.fixed_end: first of 100 completed registered independent clusters or 180 days
activation_and_stopping.interim_visibility: counts, process health and evidence failures only; no PnL comparison, ranking, parameter changes, optional stopping or promotion

universe_and_independence.registry: every row in every sequential v3 depth run, including selected, rejected, missing-book, no-trade, unresolved and settled rows
universe_and_independence.lifecycle: all mutually exclusive buckets and rebalances for one dated event
universe_and_independence.cluster: same account plus overlapping market-resolution or open-exposure windows; final deterministic clustering may merge provisional lifecycle IDs
universe_and_independence.primary_unit: independent cluster, never leg, arm, snapshot or position

causal_execution.decision_books: raw public CLOB payloads with endpoint, HTTP status, request start, response receipt, provider timestamp, market and asset identity and SHA-256
causal_execution.paper_latency_ms: maximum of 500, measured decision-book RTT and documented taker delay
causal_execution.fill_book: first separate public request beginning no earlier than decision completion plus paper latency
causal_execution.entry: FOK; insufficient full depth is no trade
causal_execution.exit: walk bid depth; partial executable exits are booked and residual inventory remains open
causal_execution.fees: archive clob-markets condition metadata plus fee-rate token response; require tbf/base_fee agreement, fd.e=1, fd.to=true and explicit fd.r; fee per level is shares times fd.r times price times one-minus-price rounded to five decimals
causal_execution.stress: two adverse ticks on each filled share
causal_execution.settlement: archive and hash the proof artifact; require event identity, final count and bucket mapping; unresolved or ambiguous settlement remains open/evidence-failed

failure_accounting.primary_sensitivity: post-signal failures receive negative planned worst-case event risk

statistics_and_promotion.primary_estimand: mean net PnL per registered independent cluster
statistics_and_promotion.paired_estimand: candidate minus baseline net PnL on the identical universe
statistics_and_promotion.tests: absolute and paired one-sided tests for all three candidates; Holm correction over six tests
statistics_and_promotion.confidence: 50000-resample cluster bootstrap, seed 20260720, one-sided Holm-adjusted 95 percent lower bounds
required: at least 30 executable completed independent clusters per arm
at least 30 net-capturable completed independent clusters per arm
positive aggregate net PnL and mean cluster expectancy
positive paired uplift with adjusted lower bound above zero
absolute adjusted lower bound above zero
net return on committed risk at least 0.02 per cluster
cash, fee, residual inventory and settlement reconciliation
statistics_and_promotion.public_record_pipeline: separate; its current zero net-capturable markouts receive no X-strategy credit
statistics_and_promotion.live_transition: never authorized here; remain paper-only after any statistical pass until separate explicit authorization and safety review

locked_implementation: xtracker_forward_v5.py activation and runtime provenance binding
amendments: any substantive change creates v6 and resets the forward sample
